files.notes: Text extracted from the project's official research paper (arXiv:2104.08663v4, 'BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models'). Contains abstract, introduction, related work, benchmark description, experimental setup, results (Tables 1-4, 9-10), an annotation-bias case study, conclusion, references (79 entries), a reproducibility checklist, and Appendices A-H. Tables and figures are damaged by PDF-to-text extraction: numeric table columns are frequently reordered/interleaved (see evidence/missing_evidence.json for the specific tables affected and how each was handled).

Official GitHub README for the BEIR software package (beir-cellar/beir). Contains installation instructions, quick-start code examples (Sentence-BERT, LoRA/vLLM, HuggingFace, Cohere API), the available-datasets table, licensing disclaimer, citation entries (including a second, later publication: Kamalloo et al. 2024, 'Resources for Brewing BEIR', SIGIR 2024 Resource Track), and contributor list. Some content (e.g. the vLLM/LoRA/Cohere examples, the SIGIR 2024 citation) post-dates the 2021 paper and describes later evolution of the software rather than the original NeurIPS 2021 paper's own experiments; such content is treated as soft/contextual evidence about the released artifact, not as evidence for any experimental claim in paper.txt.
